name: Full TikTok storyboard
prompt: Create a TikTok video storyboard to drive free signups for our product.
expected_behavior: Reads .agents/<productname>/product.md for brand voice and audience
Researches top-performing formats and hooks for the platform/category first
Asks platform, length, goal, audience, and organic-vs-paid before writing
Delivers a scene-by-scene storyboard AND a clean script
Opens with a sub-3-second hook and a single clear CTA
References video-content-frameworks.md

name: Platform-correct specs
prompt: Make a YouTube explainer script about our product.
expected_behavior: Uses 16:9, longer-form structure with a full intro hook
Places multiple retention beats and CTAs (30/60/90% + end screen)
Matches length and pacing to YouTube best practice
Provides shot-type direction per scene

name: Hook variation testing
prompt: Give me 3 hook options for a 15-second ad.
expected_behavior: Generates 3 distinct hooks using different hook formulas
Each hook lands within the first 1-3 seconds
None open with a logo or brand name
Matches hook to the viewer's emotional state on the platform

name: Problem-before-product ordering
expected_behavior: Establishes the viewer's problem before showing the product
Shows the product/feature as the resolution, not the opener
Keeps to one goal and one CTA
Adds production and accessibility notes (captions, thumbnail)

name: Paid vs organic adaptation
prompt: Turn our organic Reel concept into a paid ad version.
expected_behavior: Tightens the hook and moves the CTA earlier for paid
Designs for silent autoplay with burned-in captions
Adds UTM/tracking and a testable variation
Flags any factual claims for brand/legal approval
